title.narrative: Ulaanbaatar Urban Services and Ger Areas Development Investment Program - Tranche 2

description.narrative: Tranche 2 of the multitranche financing facility will (i) extend the urban infrastructure upgrading and spatial restructuring to two additional subcenters in the northern ger areas, namely Dambadarjaa and Denjiin, and provide additional investments in Selbe and Bayankhoshuu subcenters under Tranche 1; (ii) support the delivery of socioeconomic facilities; and (iii) further improve institutional strengthening and capacity building.

Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3525: 91% of contracts awarded and 72% disbursed as of 17 Jul 2025
Loan 3526: 95% of contracts awarded and 96% disbursed as of 17 Jul 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: Following the extension of MFF program's availability period up to 11 Dec 2026, the ongoing tranches 2 and 3 were likewise extended up to the said date. Tranche 2 encountered project implementation delays due to COVID-19 pandemic travel restrictions, PRC-Mongolia border restrictions, Russian invasion of Ukraine, substantial price escalation and cost overruns, which resulted in reluctance of bidders to bid for the packages under the project and multiple cases of rebidding; and challenges with the MUB counterpart financing due to sharp economic slowdown and the state budget fiscal challenges. Two outcome indicators were achieved: density in Dambadarjaa subcenter is 170 person per hectare, and the number of business establishments increased by 50.5%. One outcome indicator will be assessed at completion.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jul 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/45007/45007-005-apfs-en_3.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | May 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/45007/45007-005-iee-en_0.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Nov 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/45007/45007-005-rp-en_2.pdf
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | Aug 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/45007/45007-005-sddr-en_4.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Mar 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/45007/45007-005-45007-009-smr-en_0.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Under ADB financing, 12 works and goods contracts have been awarded for the design, supply, and installation of heating pipeline network in Bayankhoshuu subcenter; Dambadarjaa heating plant, roads and associated infrastructure in Dambadarjaa (two phases); construction of groundwater drainage system in Selbe subcenter (two phases); construction of public park, kindergarten, sports complex, and community development and service center in Bayankhoshuu subcenter; social housing services for project subcenters; and equipment. There are two remaining packages: (i) the community engagement package, and (ii) the consulting package for the testing and commissioning of the Dambadarjaa heating plant, both will be advertised in Q1 2024. All other consulting service contracts have been awarded and consultants were mobilized. Under EIB financing, 10 civil works contracts have been awarded; three were advertised in Dec 2022 and Mar 2023; while two are being proposed for direct contracting. The remaining are five goods contracts to be procured within 2024 prior to the completion of the related social facilities.
